reason: I already paid a creator once and got likes, no customers, and this talks about creators again. I've never heard of Mitra and it's a small beta team, so I'm not giving my Instagram and WhatsApp to them on a free month I'll have to remember to cancel.
objection: Who are you? A new startup could vanish in three months, and more views and followers don't mean people walk into my café. I need to see actual enquiries that turn into footfall, not another report full of likes.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a café or darshini near me in South Bengaluru that has used it for a few months and can show me real enquiries in their WhatsApp that turned into customers.
